meta.title: Prevention adviser level III (CP3) | Wisy Safety
cp3.lead: Every employer must be able to rely on a prevention adviser who knows the legislation on well-being at work well enough. The level III basic course provides that knowledge: risk analysis, coordination of prevention, first aid, report writing. Wisy Safety runs it in Anderlecht for companies in Brussels and Wallonia.

cp3.card_note: “CP3” is the usual abbreviation for a level III prevention adviser. Levels II and I are longer complementary trainings required in the largest companies.
cp3.s1_h2: The prevention adviser, a role set out in law
cp3.s1_intro: In Belgium, the employer sets up an internal service for prevention and protection at work. This service includes at least one prevention adviser.
cp3.s1_p1: Once the company employs twenty workers or more, this adviser is a member of staff, bound to the employer by an employment contract. Below twenty workers, the employer may take on the role personally.
cp3.s1_p2: In every case, the prevention adviser must know the well-being at work legislation that applies to the company well enough, and have the technical and scientific knowledge needed for the role: this is the requirement of article II.1-20 of the Code, which the basic course meets.

cp3.s2_h2: Which level of training for your company?
cp3.s2_intro: Two questions, based on the Code's groups A, B, C and D. Nothing is sent or stored.
cp3.c_q1: How many workers does your company employ?
cp3.c_q2: Is your business in a higher-risk sector (construction, chemicals, petrochemicals, heavy industry…)?
cp3.c_q2_hint: The Code lowers the thresholds for certain sectors, identified by their NACE code. Example: in construction, a company falls into group B from 50 workers.
cp3.r_c: Group C, or D if the employer takes on the role personally. No complementary training is required: your prevention adviser needs basic knowledge. That is what the level III course provides.
cp3.r_b: Group B. The prevention adviser who heads the internal service must have completed level II complementary training. The other prevention advisers need at least basic knowledge: the level III course suits them.
cp3.r_a: Group A. The prevention adviser who heads the internal service must have level I, the other advisers level II. The basic course remains useful for staff who are new to prevention.
cp3.r_risk: To be checked for your sector. With higher risks, your company may fall into group B, or even A, with fewer workers than the general thresholds. Your NACE code and your external prevention service will give you your exact group.
cp3.c_disclaimer: General guidance based on article II.1-2 of the Code on well-being at work: it does not replace the advice of your external prevention service.
cp3.s3_intro: The programme follows the six areas that article II.1-20 of the Code requires you to master.
cp3.p1_d: Identifying hazards, assessing risks and choosing prevention measures.
cp3.p2_d: Within the internal service, with the external service, and with outside companies working on your premises.
cp3.p3_d: The hygiene measures to put in place and monitor at the workplace.
cp3.p4_d: Organising first aid in the event of an accident or illness, and responding to serious and immediate danger.
cp3.p5_d: What the Code expects of you towards the employer, line management and workers.
cp3.p6_d: Reports, opinions and documents drawn up by the prevention adviser.
cp3.s3_note: The detailed session programme (times, exercises, assessment method) is sent with your registration confirmation.
cp3.src_t1_20: Code on well-being at work, book II, title 1, article II.1-20 (PDF, French)
cp3.s4_l1: The employee appointed, or to be appointed, as prevention adviser in a company with fewer than 200 workers (group C).
cp3.s4_l2: The employer with fewer than 20 workers who takes on the role personally (group D).
cp3.s4_l3: Assistant prevention advisers in large companies, and managers who want to understand the well-being at work framework.
cp3.s4_p: Admission requirements and the language of the session are confirmed when you get in touch.
cp3.s5_intro: Level III is the starting point of the prevention adviser pathway.
cp3.path1_p: You can act as prevention adviser in a group C or D company, backed by a certificate of attendance.
cp3.path2_w: A right and a duty for every adviser
cp3.path2_p: The Code does not set its amount for level III: it is agreed with the employer, to keep up with changes in rules and techniques.
cp3.path3_p: With the basic course and at least five years of relevant practical experience in an internal or external service, you can be admitted to level II training.

cp3.s6_h2: A recognised course: the FPS Employment list
cp3.s6_p1: A prevention adviser who has followed the basic course at an institution on the list published by the Minister of Employment is deemed to have the required knowledge. To be on that list, the institution undertakes in particular to follow the content of article II.1-20, to use trainers with practical experience of the subjects taught, to provide at least 40 hours of tuition and to issue a certificate of attendance.
cp3.s6_p2: Before registering anywhere, you can check the official list of institutions(new tab). We confirm Wisy Safety's status when you get in touch.

cp3.q1_a: It is the usual abbreviation for “level III prevention adviser”, i.e. the adviser who has basic knowledge of well-being at work. Levels II and I correspond to the complementary trainings required in group B and A companies.
cp3.q2_a: The Code requires every prevention adviser to have sufficient basic knowledge of well-being at work (article II.1-20). Following a basic course at an institution on the FPS Employment list is the way the Code provides to meet this requirement (article II.4-24).
cp3.q3: How long does the course last?
cp3.q3_a: The Code requires at least 40 hours of tuition. The exact schedule of each session (full or half days) is available on request.
cp3.q4: What do you receive at the end?
cp3.q4_a: The institution issues a certificate of attendance, as provided for in article II.4-25 of the Code. Keep it: it proves to your employer or during an inspection that you have followed the basic course.
cp3.q5_a: Yes. Every prevention adviser has the right and the duty to take refresher training every year, whatever their level. For level III, the amount is not set by the regulations: it is agreed with the employer.
cp3.q6: What are the price and the next dates?
cp3.q6_a: They are available on request, for individual registration as well as for a company group. Contact the team or call +32 2 318 86 59.
